title: POV: You Earn $3,500 a Month and Never Run Out — Jake Earns $5,500 and Is Broke Again
description:
How to stop living paycheck to paycheck, even on a normal income. Jake earns $5,500 a month and is broke by day 28. You earn $3,500 and you're calm, because you're one full month ahead.

In this POV story you'll see the exact 5 steps that got you out: finding the money leaks (food delivery, forgotten subscriptions), paying yourself first on payday, building a $1,000 starter cushion, getting one month ahead so this month's bills are paid with last month's money, and a separate bills account on autopilot.

short2.title: You're Probably Paying For Subscriptions You Forgot About 😬
short2.description: People guess they spend about $86 a month on subscriptions. The real average in one survey was $219. The 10-minute fix: check 3 months of recurring charges and cancel what you wouldn't sign up for again today.
